verses.text: But Israel broke faith over the things devoted to destruction. Achan son of Carmi, grandson of Zabdi and great-grandson of Zerah, from Judah’s tribe, took some of them. So Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel. ⚠️
Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, near Beth-aven east of Bethel. He told them, ‘Go up and scout the land.’ They went and checked out Ai. 🕵️
They came back to Joshua and said, ‘Don’t send everyone up. Two or three thousand men can go take on Ai. Don’t make the whole crew trek there; there aren’t many people.’ 🗣️
So about three thousand of Israel’s men went up, but they ran from the men of Ai. 🏃
Ai’s men struck down about thirty-six of them. They chased Israel from the city gate all the way to Shebarim and struck them on the downhill run. Israel’s courage melted like water. 😰
Joshua tore his clothes and fell facedown before Yahweh’s ark until evening. Israel’s elders did the same, with dust on their heads. 😔
Joshua cried, ‘Oh Lord Yahweh, why bring us across the Jordan just to hand us over to the Amorites and let us die? We should’ve been content to stay on the other side! 😢
‘Lord, what am I even supposed to say now that Israel has turned and run from its enemies? 😟
‘The Canaanites and everyone living in the land will hear about this, surround us, and wipe our name off the map. Then what will you do for your great name?’ 🙏
Yahweh told Joshua, ‘Get up! Why are you down on your face like this? 🗣️
‘Israel has sinned. They broke the covenant I commanded them. They took things devoted to destruction, stole them, lied about it, and hid them with their own stuff. ⚠️
‘That’s why Israel can’t stand against its enemies. They turn and run because they’ve been marked for destruction. I won’t stay with you unless you remove those devoted things from among you. 🚫

‘Get up! Set the people apart. Tell them, “Get ready for tomorrow. Yahweh, Israel’s God, says there’s something devoted to destruction among you. You can’t stand against your enemies until you remove it.”’ 📣

‘Tomorrow, come forward tribe by tribe. Yahweh will select a tribe; that tribe will come forward family by family. Then the selected family will come household by household, and the household man by man. 👥
‘The one caught with the devoted thing will be burned with everything he owns, because he broke Yahweh’s covenant and did a disgraceful thing in Israel.’ ⚖️
Joshua got up early and brought Israel forward tribe by tribe. Judah was selected. 🌅
Then Judah’s families came forward, and the Zerahite family was selected. The Zerahites came man by man, and Zabdi was selected. 👥
Zabdi’s household came forward man by man, and Achan son of Carmi, grandson of Zabdi and great-grandson of Zerah, from Judah’s tribe, was selected. ⚠️
Joshua told Achan, ‘My son, give glory to Yahweh, Israel’s God, and confess to him. Tell me what you did. Don’t hide it from me.’ 🗣️
Achan answered Joshua, ‘It’s true—I sinned against Yahweh, Israel’s God. Here’s what I did. 😔

‘I saw a beautiful Babylonian robe among the loot, plus 200 shekels of silver and a gold bar weighing 50 shekels. I wanted them, so I took them. They’re buried in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath.’ 🪙
So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent. Sure enough, the stuff was buried there, with the silver underneath. 🏃
They took everything from the middle of the tent, brought it to Joshua and all Israel, and laid it out before Yahweh. 📦

Joshua and all Israel with him took Achan son of Zerah, the silver, robe, gold bar, his sons, daughters, cattle, donkeys, sheep, tent, and everything he owned. They brought them to the Valley of Achor. ⚖️
Joshua said, ‘Why did you bring this trouble on us? Today Yahweh is bringing trouble on you.’ All Israel stoned him, burned them with fire, and stoned them again. ⚠️
They piled a huge heap of stones over him; it’s still there today. Then Yahweh turned from his fierce anger. That’s why the place is still called the Valley of Achor. 🪨
